adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` only re-renders the same OpenStruct-backed model (`fetch_embedding` builds `@embedding` from `EmbeddableHost.all`) and does not persist any changes. On the client, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, which would appear to succeed since the server always serializes success. However, the template `admin/templates/embedding.hbs` does not invoke `saveChanges` (no save button), and actual persistence for hosts happens via `EmbeddableHostsController` (`host.save(props)` / `destroyRecord`). So it’s an incomplete/misleading endpoint/action rather than a presently user-visible broken flow evidenced by the diff.
